fields.notes:
Teacher of grammar of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in Navadvīpa (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 15.5). Branch of Lord Caitanya, very dear to Him (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.29).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Sāndīpani Muni; Vasiṣṭha, the guru of Rāmacandra, is also in him (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 53).

fields.name: Śrīrāma Paṇḍita
fields.place: Navadvīpa and Kumārahaṭṭa; family from Śrīhaṭṭa
fields.notes:
Younger brother of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; son of Jaladhara Paṇḍita (Prema-vilāsa 23). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.8).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Parvata Muni, the dear friend of Nārada (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 90).

He was the younger brother of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍit (Caitanya Caritāmṛta 1.10.8-11). In his past incarnation he was Parvat Muni, a favorite friend of Nārada Muni (Gaura- gaṇoddeśa- dīpikā 90). Ramai (alias Śrī Rāma Paṇḍit) accompanied Lord Gaurāṅga while singing kīrtana (Caitanya Bagavata 2.18.11-53). When Lord Caitanya revealed Himself to the devotees, Ramai was sent to carry the message to Advaita Ācārya in Śāntipura (Caitanya Bagavata 2.6.9-71). He participated in a drama, along with Śrīvāsa, in the house of Candrasekhar (Caitanya Bagavata 2.18.52).

fields.place: Navadvīpa and Kumārahaṭṭa; family from Śrīhaṭṭa
fields.notes: Brother of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; son of Jaladhara Paṇḍita (Prema-vilāsa 23). Branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.9).

fields.name: Rāmāi (servant of the Lord in Purī)
fields.notes:
Servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in Purī: with Nandāi and Govinda he did all the work of the Lord's house, and filled twenty-two pots of water every day (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.143–144). Branch of Lord Caitanya.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Payoda, a servant of Kṛṣṇa (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 139).

He was an attendant of Lord Caitanya. Caitanya Caritāmṛta 1.10.143-144 states that Ramai and Nandai, the twentieth and twenty-first amongst the devotees in Jagannātha Purī, always assisted Govinda in rendering service to the Lord day and night. Everyday Ramai filled twenty-two big water pots. He was Payoda in his past incarnation (Gaura- gaṇoddeśa- dīpikā 139). In Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja's Śrī Caitanyagaṇoddeśadīpikā (ms. preserved in Orissa State Museum Catalogue no. L 470 {B}) Ramai's name is mentioned along with other followers like Singha Bhaṭṭa, Kamal Bhaṭṭa, Nandai.

He was a devotee of Lord Gaurāṅga. Nothing is known about him, other than that he was a teacher of Lord Gaurāṅga, with Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita (Caitanya-maṅgala Ādi p. 64, Nāmāmṛta-samudra 61, Vaiṣṇava-vandanā; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna places Vasiṣṭha Muni, Rāmacandra's guru, in Gaṅgādāsa Paṇḍita (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 53); this record said before that Sudarśana was Vasiṣṭha.
